description: This source file contains pytest-based test cases for the 'ExpressTemplate' class, which is part of a project scaffolding tool. It verifies template initialization, project creation, post-processing execution, configuration loading, and variable substitution within templates.

classes.name: ProjectConfig

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration of supported project types, including 'EXPRESS'.

classes.description: Class encapsulating initialization information for a template, including commands for environment configuration, building, installation, running, openapi generation, and testing.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for initializing projects from templates, executing post-processing scripts, and loading configuration files.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Class that provides template files and resources based on a directory path.
